withheld_reason.contributions: THE AMOUNT COLUMN IS NOT ON THE SCAN. The contribution sheet is a LANDSCAPE form that was fed through the scanner in PORTRAIT orientation, so the right ~23% of the sheet - the Zipcode and Amount columns, and the whole '<=$50' box - is cropped off the page image. What survives is the '>$50' box ($571.50) and two complete Date / Name / Mailing Address rows. The per-row amounts therefore do not exist in this document and CANNOT be read; taking them from the filer's Pre-Election sibling 1058 (which carries the identical cumulative figures and the same two donors at 200.00 and 371.50) would be inference, not transcription. The side ships NO rows and claims NO sum; the two rows are parked with blank amounts so a future re-scan or an owner ruling can complete them without re-reading. Nothing is lost to the corpus: 1058's contribution itemization is already published and reconciles exactly to the same 571.50.

contributions.detail: no sum claimed - the Amount column is physically off the scanned page (see withheld_reason). The schedule's own '>$50' box IS legible at $571.50 and equals the module's stated total, so the page's own gate is intact even though the rows behind it are not readable

expenditures.detail: exact - the 24 typed rows sum to 6,627.75, equal to the schedule's own printed box and to the cover. Cross-checked against the filer's Pre-Election filing 1058, whose already-published 24-row itemization is the same ledger and closes on the same figure

_meta_itemized.page_gates: p3 (ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT, landscape, typed) prints 'Total amount of expenditures $6,627.75'; its 24 real rows sum to 6,627.75 to the cent, and the cover states the same figure - the side gates on both. The specimen row ($512.00) is excluded and the proof is arithmetic: including it gives 7,139.75. p2 (ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT) prints '>$50 $571.50', which equals the module's stated total, but the page is CROPPED and carries no amount column, so no row-level gate is possible - hence the withheld side. This filing repeats its own Pre-Election report (1058) figure for figure: 571.50 / 6,627.75 / -6,056.25, and the 24 expense rows are the same 24 rows, so the ledger is CUMULATIVE, not period-scoped.

_meta_itemized.notes: A POST-ELECTION filing that re-files the PRE-ELECTION report unchanged (same three cover figures, same 24 expense rows as 1058) - the filer had no post-period activity. Typed sheets throughout. SOURCE PROPERTY THIS BRIEF DID NOT ANTICIPATE: p2 is a LANDSCAPE form scanned in PORTRAIT, which crops the Zipcode and Amount columns and the '<=$50' box clean off the page image - a scanner defect, not a redaction and not a filer omission (the same sheet is complete on 1058). p3 was scanned landscape and is complete. The printed SPECIMEN rows survive UNSTRUCK on both sheets ('Jon and Jane Doe $435.00' on p2, 'Name of Business $512.00' on p3) and both are dropped; on this variant of the blank form the specimen date is printed 8/25/14 rather than the 8/25/10 seen elsewhere in the corpus. One expense row pays 'Corrie Forsling' $176.50 for Slate Cards - Forsling is herself a 2014 Summit candidate (docs 1086 / 1245), so this is candidate-to-candidate slate cost sharing, not a vendor. GEOMETRY IS DECLARED on both pages because the printed rules are too faint for plain band detection (p2 returns 49 bands that are mostly text lines; p3 returns only 3). Both frames are FITS measured from the pages' own rules: p2 pitch 1.90830 anchored on the 33 clean rules below y29, max residual 0.036% of page height, mean 0.014%, extrapolated up four bands to the header at y21.83; p3 pitch 2.26350 anchored at y27.476, explaining 5 of 5 detected rules with mean residual 0.0086%. Both were validated by render-back: p2 band 3 resolves to the Siddoway row and p3 band 26 to the '10/22/2014 Summit County News / Advertisement / $227.50' row.
